reason: This gap aims to explore the variability in maternal gestational weight gain patterns among SUID (Sudden Unexpected Infant Death) cases across different pregnancy stages, using data from the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NCFRP). While this study will provide descriptive insights into how prenatal weight gain varies within SUID cases, it cannot establish causality or incidence rates due to its case-only design. The findings would be limited in their ability to draw causal conclusions but could offer valuable information on variations within the SUID population.
